failure_layer_verdict.conclusion: STALE_CREDENTIALS. The banked NAS credentials (user_len=7, pass_len=8) are rejected by the SMB server at 10.10.55.55 across all protocol variants (SMB2, native) with NT_STATUS_LOGON_FAILURE, and by DSM HTTP across all method+version combinations with error 400. The 2026-09-14 T3 receipt shows the SAME sheet worked before the 2026-09-16 rotation-check ingestion. Highest-likelihood root cause: the NAS-side password was rotated post-2026-09-16 but the sheet ingestion mis-captured the new value, or the RMS admin rotated it again since then. Ask the RMS admin to confirm the CURRENT NAS creds and re-drop the sheet. The credentials themselves — not the network path — are the block; JUMP tunnel + DSM HTTPS + SMB TCP all confirmed OK.
